job.title: Senior Digital Solutions Developer
job.description:
This is: the job

This is a senior, hands-on opportunity for a Digital Solutions Developer who can comfortably bridge the gap between technology and the business. Sitting within IT and supporting the systems used by the marketing and Clients & Markets teams, you will take ownership of a varied digital environment where technical capability, communication and independent problem-solving are equally important.

The core of the role is Microsoft Dynamics 365, including Sales and Customer Insights, alongside Power Platform and the organisation's public website. You will work across both front-end activities, such as building campaigns, and more technical CRM, automation, integration and troubleshooting work. Storyblok, HTML and CSS also form part of the environment, with Templafy another important platform that can be learned on the job.

This is a 12-month fixed term contract based in Melbourne CBD, with an ASAP start and a 60/40 hybrid working model - three days per week in the office. You will join an established professional services environment and work within an applications team as part of a broader IT function.

This is: what you'll do

  • Manage and enhance Microsoft Dynamics 365 across Sales and Customer Insights, supporting both day-to-day requirements and ongoing improvements.
  • Develop and maintain solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Deliver CRM campaigns and customer journeys when required, including associated front-end development.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues independently, investigate root causes and drive problems through to resolution.
  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions without relying on others to define the approach.
  • Support and enhance the public website through Storyblok, including HTML and CSS work where required.
  • Manage integrations, APIs and connected applications across the wider digital ecosystem.
  • Learn, support and enhance additional platforms such as Templafy, taking ownership of unfamiliar technology when required.
  • Collaborate with IT and Clients & Markets stakeholders, communicating clearly about requirements, challenges, progress and delivery.
  • Maintain high standards of quality, documentation, testing, governance and attention to detail.

This is: what you'll need

  • Strong, hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - this is a must-have.
  • Practical Microsoft Power Platform experience - this is a must-have.
  • The ability to work across both Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Insights or marketing-related functionality.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and the ability to investigate and resolve issues independently.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and determining how those solutions should be delivered.
  • HTML and CSS capability.
  • Experience with a CMS. Storyblok or another headless CMS would be highly regarded.
  • A balance of technical depth and strong communication skills. This role needs someone who can do the technical work and communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
  • A proactive approach and the confidence to investigate unfamiliar systems and work out how they operate.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when developing, testing and releasing changes.
  • Strong judgement and communication. If something cannot be delivered as requested, you will be comfortable raising it early and explaining the options.
  • Experience operating at a senior level in a structured corporate or professional services environment.
  • Templafy experience is advantageous but not essential. More important is your ability to learn and take ownership of new platforms quickly.

This is: the perks

  • Take genuine ownership of a varied Microsoft and digital technology environment, rather than working in a narrow development role.
  • Work across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Storyblok, web technologies, integrations and marketing technology in the one engagement.
  • Join an established applications team within a professional services environment, with exposure across both IT and Clients & Markets.
  • Enjoy a 60/40 hybrid working arrangement, with three days per week in the Melbourne CBD office.

job.title: Senior Business Analyst - Transaction Banking Gateway Replacement
job.description:
This is: the job

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join a major transaction banking and payment gateway replacement initiative. This is a complex, high-profile program focused on replacing a legacy payment gateway with a contemporary solution and creating a more efficient, customer-focused payments experience.

You will work across business and technology teams to understand current payment and banking processes, shape future-state requirements and support solution design through to testing and operational readiness. The scope includes payment gateway modernisation, settlement and reconciliation, systems integration, Apple Pay, Google Wallet and 3D Secure.

This is a 6-month contingent contract with potential extension, based in Melbourne with a hybrid model of 3 days in the office. The engagement is scheduled to commence on 4 January 2027.

This is: what you'll do

  • Lead discovery and requirements workshops with business, technology and payment stakeholders.
  • Analyse and document current-state and future-state payment and banking processes.
  • Deliver clear business and functional requirements, user stories, business rules, process models and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive analysis across payment gateway, settlement, reconciliation and associated business systems.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Developers and SMEs to evaluate options and define fit-for-purpose solutions.
  • Assess downstream impacts across customer channels, finance, operations and reporting, including Apple Pay, Google Wallet and 3D Secure.
  • Manage requirements traceability and identify risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies throughout delivery.
  • Support solution design reviews, backlog refinement, prioritisation, release planning and implementation activities.
  • Support SIT, UAT, defect management and validation of delivered solutions against business requirements.
  • Drive business readiness by supporting training, operational transition and stakeholder decision-making.

This is: what you'll need

  • 8+ years' experience as a Senior Business Analyst delivering large-scale business and technology initiatives.
  • Strong capability in requirements elicitation, process modelling, stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation.
  • Demonstrated experience working across end-to-end project delivery lifecycles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and process improvement capability.
  • Experience supporting solution design, testing, business readiness and implementation.
  • Payments or transaction banking experience is highly desirable, particularly payment gateways, merchant acquiring, settlement and reconciliation.
  • Exposure to digital wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Wallet, along with 3D Secure, will be advantageous.
  • Experience with system integration and knowledge of PCI DSS and payment security requirements is desirable.
  • Banking, financial services, eCommerce, contact centre or customer-facing digital platform experience will be well regarded.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to make complex business and technical information clear to varied audiences.

This is: the perks

  • Work on a high-profile payment gateway modernisation initiative with significant business and customer impact.
  • Gain exposure to contemporary payments capabilities including Apple Pay, Google Wallet and 3D Secure.
  • Play an influential role across discovery, solution design, delivery, testing and operational readiness.
  • Secure a 6-month Melbourne contract with potential extension and a hybrid model of 3 days in the office.

job.title: SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead
job.description:
This is: the job
An exciting opportunity for an experienced SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead to take ownership of the reporting and analytics workstream within a major enterprise SAP transformation in Melbourne.

This hands-on leadership role will shape the target-state reporting architecture across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, embedded analytics and Fiori-based reporting. You will set the strategy and standards while remaining actively involved in solution design, data modelling, quality assurance and delivery.

This 12-month contract is ideal for someone who has successfully led SAP reporting and analytics through a full S/4HANA implementation and enjoys combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical decision-making.

This is: what you'll do

  • Lead the reporting and analytics workstream across SAP S/4HANA and the broader SAP analytics landscape.
  • Define the target-state reporting architecture and determine the right approach across embedded, real-time and enterprise reporting.
  • Drive requirements workshops with business stakeholders and functional leads to prioritise statutory, operational, management and self-service reporting.
  • Oversee the design and delivery of reports, dashboards, KPIs, CDS views and analytical data models.
  • Establish standards for semantic models, data models, dashboards, KPI definitions, naming conventions and version control.
  • Drive report rationalisation, reducing unnecessary legacy reporting and promoting standard SAP functionality and clean-core principles.
  • Manage reporting testing across SIT, UAT, data reconciliation and defect resolution.
  • Collaborate with data migration, security, architecture, integration and functional teams to deliver trusted, governed and secure reporting.
  • Lead SAP Datasphere and SAC consultants and partner resources, managing priorities, delivery quality, risks and dependencies.
  • Define the transition to hypercare and BAU, including knowledge transfer, documentation, support processes and ongoing enhancement governance.

This is: what you'll need

  • Proven experience leading a reporting and analytics workstream through at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation, from design through to hypercare.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Data Products and S/4HANA embedded analytics.
  • Practical experience with CDS views, Fiori analytical applications, analytical models, dashboards and KPI frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of SAP data models and reporting across areas such as FI/CO, MM, SD and/or PP.
  • Experience translating complex business reporting requirements and KPIs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of reporting governance, data quality, reconciliation, business glossaries and metric definitions.
  • Understanding of role-based access, row-level security and reporting authorisation requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience leading delivery teams, consultants and implementation partner resources.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including confidence working with senior business, technical and program leaders.
  • Excellent analytical, communication and problem-solving skills with the ability to challenge legacy approaches and drive pragmatic outcomes.

This is: the perks

  • Take ownership of reporting and analytics within a significant enterprise-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Shape the future-state analytics landscape across SAC, Datasphere, embedded analytics and SAP data capabilities.
  • Work with senior program leaders, functional teams and specialist SAP resources in a highly visible role.
  • Build valuable end-to-end transformation experience across design, build, testing, cutover, hypercare and transition to BAU.

We're seeking an experienced SAP Instructional Designer / Trainer to play a key role in a large-scale ERP transformation program delivering SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud across Finance, Supply Chain, Asset Management and Service Operations.
